$comment: Standalone example: expected landscape vs portrait preload behavior per viewport. Copy to perf-hero.config.json (or point PERF_HERO_CONFIG at it) to move viewports between buckets without editing scripts/perf-hero-check.mjs. `preload_buckets` maps orientation → Supabase storage bucket name; `viewports.<key>.preload_orientation` picks which one that viewport must download (expect) and which must stay silent (forbid). Explicit `expect_bucket`/`forbid_bucket` still win over the orientation shorthand; env vars EXPECT_BUCKET_<VP>/FORBID_BUCKET_<VP> still win over the config file.
